name: command-palette
summary: The interactive header GLOBAL SEARCH / omnibox — a search bar with a category picker (Metric/Log/Flow), a query field with a live SUGGESTIONS dropdown, an Execute action (⏎) that flips to a red error icon on a parse error, a clear (⌫), and a time-range picker. For cross-app search / a command surface, NOT a plain list filter. Composes obs-select + obs-input + obs-date-time-picker (kind=range) + obs-icon. The turnkey form of the `command-palette` recipe.
selectHint: A GLOBAL / cross-app search or command surface (category + query + Execute) in the header? -> obs-command-palette. A plain search of a single list/table? -> the obs-input `search` type, NOT this.
whenToUse: The header omnibox for global/cross-app search or a query-builder command surface — pick a category, type a query, Execute. One per app chrome.
insteadOf: a hand-built search bar (icon + select + input + button)
the obs-input search type used for a global command surface (that is for filtering one list)

variants.name: default
variants.what: search icon + category picker + query field + Execute (+ clear).

variants.name: no-category
variants.what: omit `categories` -> a plain global search bar (search + query + Execute).
variants.usage: when there is no category axis

variants.name: error
variants.what: the `error` prop -> Execute turns red with the message + an exclamation icon; Execute disabled until the query parses.

variants.name: with-suggestions
variants.what: a live autocomplete dropdown under the query (the `suggestions` prop).

variants.name: with-time-range
variants.what: a reused obs-date-time-picker (kind=range) on the right for the query time window.

variants.name: overlay
variants.what: a search-icon trigger → a centered, blurred Cmd+K modal palette (overlay=true).

variants.name: block
variants.what: a wider bar — grows to a 1100px cap (vs the 680–800 default). Bounded, never edge-to-edge.
variants.usage: a roomy standalone search page / wide header

variants.name: centered
variants.what: align="center" centers the bar within its container (default is left).

sizes.name: default
sizes.note: a single rounded bordered bar; min-width 680 so the query is never cramped, grows to 800; block widens to a 1100 cap; align left (default) / center.

states.name: empty
states.what: just the placeholder; the clear button is hidden.

states.name: typing
states.what: a query is entered; clear button shows; Enter or Execute runs it.

states.name: error
states.what: the Execute icon becomes a red exclamation (obs-icon exclamationCircle); the border turns red; Execute is disabled until the query parses.

value.note: the query text (two-way via the `input` event).

categories.note: category-picker options ([{value,label}] or a comma list). Empty -> no category picker (a plain search bar).

category.note: the current category value (else the first option).

error.note: a parse-error message -> Execute shows the error state (red + exclamation) and is disabled.

clearable.note: show the clear (backspace) button when there is a query.

suggestions.note: autocomplete options (strings) → a live dropdown while the query is focused; filtered by the query. Click / Arrow+Enter fills the query (emits `suggest`).

time-range.note: show the time-range picker on the right (REUSES obs-date-time-picker kind=range — the hero TimeRangePicker: relative presets + Custom).

overlay.note: render as a header search-ICON trigger that opens the palette as a centered, near-top MODAL over a blurred/dimmed backdrop (Cmd+K style; <dialog>.showModal like obs-modal). Esc / backdrop-click closes. This is how the product header search opens.

block.note: wider bar — grows to 1100px (vs the 680–800 default). Bounded, never edge-to-edge full-bleed.

align.note: horizontal alignment of the bar within its container: left (default) or center.

events.name: execute
events.note: the query was run (Enter or Execute click); blocked while `error` is set.

events.name: clear
events.note: the clear button was clicked (query reset).

events.name: suggest
events.note: a suggestion was picked from the autocomplete dropdown (fills the query).

decisionFlow: A GLOBAL / cross-app search or a command/query surface in the header? -> obs-command-palette.
A plain search that filters ONE list/table? -> the obs-input `search` type, NOT this.
Is there a category/scope axis (Monitor / Metric / Log)? -> set `categories`; else omit it for a plain bar.
Invalid query? -> set `error` with the message; Execute shows red + is disabled until it clears.
Where does it live? -> the obs-app-header search area (default slot).
Need a full modal Cmd+K palette with a results list? -> compose obs-modal + this bar (route-away); this element is the inline omnibox.
Query has a known vocabulary (metric names)? -> pass `suggestions` for a live autocomplete dropdown.
Results are time-scoped (metrics/logs)? -> `time-range` adds the reused obs-date-time-picker (presets + Custom).
Should the header search open as a focused Cmd+K modal (icon -> centered blurred palette)? -> `overlay`. Inline always-visible bar? -> default (no overlay).
How wide / where? -> default is a 680–800 left-aligned bar; a roomy standalone surface -> `block` (grows to a 1100 cap); center it in its container -> align="center".

default.useWhen: the header global-search omnibox — category + query + Execute for cross-app search
default.dontUse: for filtering a single list (use the obs-input search type)
default.example: obs-app-header search area: All / Monitor / Metric + a query + Execute

no-category.useWhen: a plain global search with no scope axis

error.useWhen: the typed query fails to parse and the user must fix it before running
error.dontUse: the query is valid/empty (no error state)
error.example: error="Unexpected token near '='" -> red Execute + exclamation

with-suggestions.useWhen: the query has a known vocabulary (metric names, keywords) worth autocompleting
with-suggestions.dontUse: a free-text search with no suggestions

with-time-range.useWhen: the query results are time-scoped (metrics/logs over a window)
with-time-range.example: time-range → a Last 1 Hour / Last 24 Hours / Custom picker on the right

overlay.useWhen: the header search should open the palette as a focused Cmd+K modal (the product behaviour) rather than sit inline
overlay.dontUse: an always-visible inline search bar is wanted (default mode)
overlay.example: overlay -> a search icon in obs-app-header; click it -> a centered blurred palette

block.useWhen: a roomy standalone search page or a wide header where the 680–800 default feels cramped
block.dontUse: a compact header slot (the default already keeps a min-width 680 so the query is never cramped)
block.example: block -> the bar grows to a bounded 1100px cap

centered.useWhen: a standalone / hero search surface where the bar should sit in the middle of its container
centered.dontUse: the header search area (left-aligned is the product default)
centered.example: align="center" -> the bar centers; the showcase playground uses this

usage.note: One per app shell (the header search). Turnkey element for the command-palette recipe; the product uses a CodeMirror query editor, this uses obs-input.

do: Place it in the obs-app-header search area (default slot).
Wire `execute` to your search/route and `category` to the scope.
Use `error` for parse feedback; keep Execute disabled until the query is valid.
Only use it for global/cross-app search — a list filter is the obs-input search type.
dont: Don't use it to filter a single table/list (that's obs-input search).
Don't hardcode the categories in the query — the category is a separate scope axis.
Don't hardcode colours — the error state uses --secondary-red.

a11y.summary: The query is an obs-input (labelled by the placeholder/aria); the category is an obs-select (keyboard-navigable). Enter runs the query. On a parse error the message replaces Execute and the action is disabled; announce it via aria-live so screen-reader users hear the invalid-query feedback.
a11y.notes: Give the query field a discernible name (the placeholder + an aria-label). Enter executes; the clear button has aria-label="Clear". Announce results count / parse errors via a live region. If wrapped in a modal Cmd+K palette, trap focus and restore it on close.

knownIssues: Simplified vs the product: the query is a plain obs-input (with a suggestions dropdown), not the product's CodeMirror editor with tokenized parsing — appropriate for a DS omnibox. A full Cmd+K modal palette with a live results list is a route-away (obs-modal + this bar).
